name: utils
title: Shared helpers
description: The class merge helper `cn` and `copyText` (host callback, Clipboard API, then a selection copy that works over plain HTTP) shared by every Tailwind item, and the app shell's header slot for an embedded page's controls (`ScreenHeaderSlotContext`), installed once in components/utils/. Shared phone/media/visual-viewport hooks and nonfatal viewer storage helpers live here too.
